title: Bad Omen Tools
description: This resource pack makes netherite tools look like thay drank a bad omen potion!
body: [](https://discord.gg/uPzGGEa9nA) This resource pack transforms your gear into a darker, more ominous style inspired by the Bad Omen effect. Netherite tools are reimagined with deep, shadowy tones, eerie red accents, and subtle red glows that make them feel powerful and cursed at the same time. Each tool has been carefully redesigned to stand out while still fitting naturally within Minecraft’s aesthetic. The Totem of Undying has also been completely overhauled, taking on a sinister Bad Omen theme. With a pale tone and glowing red eyes, it feels less like a charm of protection and more like a forbidden relic keeping you alive. The design ties closely to the illagers, giving your survival experience a darker, more intense vibe. Perfect for players who enjoy a more menacing or lore-heavy look, this pack adds atmosphere without changing gameplay. Whether you're exploring, fighting raids, or just flexing your gear, everything feels more powerful and a little cursed.
